points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 卡尔·马克思1818年5月5日出生于德国特里尔的一个犹太裔中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是律师，后来改信基督教以获得更好的职业机会。马克思在特里尔接受了基础教育，展现出卓越的学术才能。1835年，他毕业于特里尔中学，毕业论文《青年在选择职业时的考虑》显示了他早期的哲学思考和对社会正义的关注。这段时期奠定了他的思想基础，使他开始质疑社会不平等现象。
points.descriptionEn: Karl Marx was born on May 5, 1818, in Trier, Germany, to a middle-class Jewish family that later converted to Christianity. His father was a lawyer. Marx received his early education in Trier, demonstrating exceptional academic abilities. In 1835, he graduated from Trier Gymnasium with a thesis 'Reflections on Choosing One's Career,' which revealed his early philosophical thinking and concern for social justice. This period laid the foundation for his thoughts, beginning to question social inequality.

points.title: 大学哲学研究
points.description: 1836年，马克思进入柏林大学学习法律，但很快转向哲学研究。他加入了青年黑格尔派，深入研究黑格尔辩证法，并开始批判性地发展自己的思想。1841年，马克思完成博士论文《德谟克利特的自然哲学和伊壁鸠鲁的自然哲学的差别》，获得耶拿大学博士学位（因柏林大学保守氛围而未能在柏林获得）。在柏林期间，马克思的思想从黑格尔唯心主义逐渐转向唯物主义，为后来的历史唯物主义奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1836, Marx enrolled at the University of Berlin to study law but quickly shifted to philosophy. He joined the Young Hegelians, deeply studying Hegelian dialectics and beginning to critically develop his own ideas. In 1841, Marx completed his doctoral thesis 'The Difference Between the Democritean and Epicurean Philosophy of Nature,' earning his doctorate from the University of Jena (unable to obtain one in Berlin due to its conservative atmosphere). During his time in Berlin, Marx's thinking gradually shifted from Hegelian idealism to materialism, laying the foundation for his later historical materialism.

points.title: 革命思想形成
points.description: 1843年，马克思因激进政治观点被普鲁士政府驱逐，移居巴黎。在这里，他遇到了恩格斯，两人开始了终生的友谊与合作。马克思深入研究法国大革命历史和社会主义思想，接触了工人阶级运动。1844年，他撰写《1844年经济学哲学手稿》，首次系统阐述异化劳动理论。1845年，马克思因激进活动被法国政府驱逐，前往布鲁塞尔。巴黎时期是马克思思想成熟的关键阶段，他从哲学批判转向政治经济学批判，形成了无产阶级革命理论的基本框架。
points.descriptionEn: In 1843, Marx was expelled from Prussia due to his radical political views and moved to Paris. There, he met Engels, beginning a lifelong friendship and collaboration. Marx deeply studied the history of the French Revolution and socialist ideas, coming into contact with the working-class movement. In 1844, he wrote the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844,' systematically elaborating the theory of alienated labor for the first time. In 1845, Marx was expelled from France for his radical activities and moved to Brussels. The Paris period was crucial for the maturation of Marx's thought, shifting from philosophical critique to political economy critique and forming the basic framework of his proletarian revolution theory.

points.title: 理论体系构建
points.description: 1845年，马克思定居布鲁塞尔，与恩格斯继续合作。1845-1846年，他们合著《德意志意识形态》，首次系统阐述历史唯物主义基本原理。1847年，马克思加入'正义者同盟'，并将其改组为'共产主义者同盟'。1848年，马克思受共产主义者同盟委托，撰写《共产党宣言》，这部著作成为国际共产主义运动的纲领性文件。1848年欧洲革命爆发后，马克思积极支持革命运动，并在《新莱茵报》上发表大量文章。1849年，比利时政府应普鲁士政府要求驱逐马克思，他被迫流亡伦敦。布鲁塞尔时期是马克思理论体系形成的关键阶段，历史唯物主义和阶级斗争理论在此期间成熟。
points.descriptionEn: In 1845, Marx settled in Brussels and continued his collaboration with Engels. From 1845 to 1846, they co-authored 'The German Ideology,' systematically elaborating the basic principles of historical materialism for the first time. In 1847, Marx joined the 'League of the Just' and reorganized it into the 'Communist League.' In 1848, Marx was commissioned by the Communist League to write 'The Communist Manifesto,' which became a programmatic document for the international communist movement. When the European Revolution of 1848 broke out, Marx actively supported the revolutionary movement and published numerous articles in the 'Rheinische Zeitung.' In 1849, at the request of the Prussian government, the Belgian government expelled Marx, forcing him into exile in London. The Brussels period was crucial for the formation of Marx's theoretical system, during which historical materialism and the theory of class struggle matured.

points.title: 资本研究与革命活动
points.description: 1849年，马克思移居伦敦，在此度过余生。初期生活贫困，依靠恩格斯的资助和撰稿为生。1850年代，马克思深入研究政治经济学，大量阅读英国议会文件和经济学著作。1867年，出版《资本论》第一卷，这是他最重要的经济学著作，系统分析了资本主义生产方式的运行机制。1864年，马克思参与创立'国际工人协会'（第一国际），并成为其领导核心。1870年代后，马克思因健康恶化减少公开活动，但仍继续《资本论》后续卷的写作工作。伦敦时期是马克思学术成就的高峰期，《资本论》的出版标志着马克思主义理论体系的最终形成，对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1849, Marx moved to London, where he would spend the rest of his life. Initially living in poverty, he relied on financial support from Engels and his writing income. During the 1850s, Marx deeply studied political economy, extensively reading British parliamentary documents and economic works. In 1867, he published the first volume of 'Das Kapital,' his most important economic work, systematically analyzing the operating mechanisms of the capitalist mode of production. In 1864, Marx participated in founding the 'International Workingmen's Association' (First International) and became a core leader. After the 1870s, Marx reduced public activities due to declining health but continued working on subsequent volumes of 'Das Kapital.' The London period marked the peak of Marx's academic achievements. The publication of 'Das Kapital' signified the final formation of Marxist theoretical system, exerting profound influence on later generations.

points.title: 逝世与历史影响
points.description: 1883年3月14日，马克思在伦敦家中逝世，享年64岁。他被安葬在伦敦海格特公墓。马克思逝世后，其思想由恩格斯整理并传播开来。1884年，恩格斯出版《家庭、私有制和国家的起源》，进一步发展了马克思主义理论。马克思的思想在19世纪末至20世纪对世界产生了深远影响，成为国际共产主义运动的理论基础，催生了苏联、中国等社会主义国家的建立。尽管20世纪末苏联解体，但马克思主义作为分析社会的方法论仍然具有重要价值，对当代资本主义批判、全球化研究等领域持续产生影响。马克思被广泛认为是人类历史上最具影响力的思想家之一。
points.descriptionEn: On March 14, 1883, Marx died at his home in London at the age of 64. He was buried in Highgate Cemetery, London. After Marx's death, his thoughts were organized and disseminated by Engels. In 1884, Engels published 'The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State,' further developing Marxist theory. Marx's thought had a profound impact on the world from the late 19th to the 20th century, becoming the theoretical foundation of the international communist movement and giving rise to the establishment of socialist countries like the Soviet Union and China. Despite the collapse of the Soviet Union at the end of the 20th century, Marxism as a methodology for analyzing society still holds significant value, continuing to influence fields such as contemporary capitalist critique and globalization studies. Marx is widely regarded as one of the most influential thinkers in human history.

supporter.zh: 马克思被支持者视为人类历史上最伟大的社会科学家和革命思想家之一。他的历史唯物主义和辩证法为理解社会发展提供了科学方法论，揭露了资本主义剥削的本质。马克思对阶级斗争的分析和对无产阶级解放的号召，激励了无数人为社会正义而斗争。他的思想不仅改变了世界政治格局，还深刻影响了社会学、经济学、哲学等多个学科。马克思主义作为批判性分析工具，至今仍为理解当代社会不平等、全球化矛盾等问题提供重要视角。
supporter.en: Marx is regarded by his supporters as one of the greatest social scientists and revolutionary thinkers in human history. His historical materialism and dialectics provided a scientific methodology for understanding social development, exposing the essence of capitalist exploitation. Marx's analysis of class struggle and call for the emancipation of the proletariat have inspired countless people to fight for social justice. His thought not only changed the world political landscape but also profoundly influenced multiple disciplines such as sociology, economics, and philosophy. As a critical analytical tool, Marxism continues to provide important perspectives for understanding contemporary social inequality and globalization contradictions.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马克思的理论存在严重缺陷，其历史决定论忽视了人类主观能动性和文化因素。马克思对资本主义的预言未能完全实现，如资本主义并未如他所预测那样崩溃，反而展现出强大的适应能力。实践中的马克思主义国家往往导致极权主义和经济失败，如苏联的古拉格和中国的文化大革命。马克思的阶级斗争理论被批评为过于简化复杂的社会关系，忽视了民族、宗教等其他重要社会维度。此外，马克思的个人生活也被批评为言行不一，如依赖恩格斯资助却批判资本主义剥削。
critic.en: Critics argue that Marx's theory has serious flaws, as his historical determinism overlooks human agency and cultural factors. Marx's predictions about capitalism have not fully materialized; capitalism has not collapsed as he predicted but instead demonstrated remarkable adaptability. Marxist states in practice have often led to totalitarianism and economic failure, such as the Gulag in the Soviet Union and the Cultural Revolution in China. Marx's theory of class struggle is criticized for oversimplifying complex social relations and ignoring other important dimensions like nationality and religion. Additionally, Marx's personal life has been criticized for inconsistency, as he relied on Engels' financial support while criticizing capitalist exploitation.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，马克思被复杂地定义为既是革命家又是学者。他的思想体系被公认为现代社会科学的奠基性贡献之一，尽管其政治实践结果充满争议。马克思的《资本论》被视为经济学经典，其对商品拜物教的批判至今仍具启发性。在流行文化中，马克思常被简化为共产主义象征，但学术界更重视其作为社会分析家的贡献。当代学者如霍克海默、阿多诺等法兰克福学派思想家，以及当代马克思主义者如大卫·哈维，都在不同程度上发展了马克思的思想。马克思的形象在历史长河中不断被重新诠释，反映了不同时代的社会关切和理论需求。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Marx is complexly defined as both a revolutionary and a scholar. His theoretical system is widely recognized as one of the foundational contributions to modern social sciences, although the results of its political practice remain controversial. Marx's 'Das Kapital' is regarded as an economic classic, and his critique of commodity fetishism continues to be enlightening. In popular culture, Marx is often simplified as a symbol of communism, but academia emphasizes his contribution as a social analyst. Contemporary scholars such as those of the Frankfurt School like Horkheimer and Adorno, as well as contemporary Marxists like David Harvey, have developed Marx's thought to varying degrees. Marx's image has been constantly reinterpreted throughout history, reflecting the social concerns and theoretical needs of different eras.

self.zh: 哲学家们只是用不同的方式解释世界，而问题在于改变世界。
self.en: The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways; the point is to change it.

others.zh: 马克思是达尔文以来最伟大的社会科学家，他的思想对现代世界的影响无人能及。
others.en: Marx was the greatest social scientist since Darwin, and his influence on the modern world is unparalleled.
